reportedScale.scope: current official README; paper v1 reports >10 h and 41 participants

egoemg.observations: Bilateral sEMG/IMU, ego wide-angle RGB and external RGB-D reference video.
egoemg.labels: Hand motion and wrist articulation targets from mocap reconstruction.
egoemg.annotationEvidence: Optical marker measurements followed by learned hand-model reconstruction.
egoemg.limitations: Current release is a preview shard; original paper reported >10 h / 41 participants. External RGB-D is a reference view.
egoemg.name: EgoEMG
egoemg.accessNote: Official Baidu Netdisk preview shard and benchmark code; full public hours not independently verified.

egopressure.observations: Ego/exo RGB-D and a Sensel pressure-sensitive touchpad.
egopressure.labels: Hand meshes and pressure intensities projected onto contact vertices.
egopressure.annotationEvidence: Measured touchpad pressure combined with multi-view hand-model optimization.
egopressure.limitations: Planar normal-pressure interaction; no general whole-hand object tactile or shear measurements.
egopressure.name: EgoPressure
egopressure.accessNote: Official dataset download and use agreement.

ego4d.observations: Wearable first-person video; additional modalities are available for subsets.
ego4d.labels: Narrations, temporal activity labels and benchmark-specific annotations.
ego4d.annotationEvidence: Human annotation; coverage varies by benchmark and recording.
ego4d.limitations: Most clips do not include metric hand pose or robot actions.
ego4d.name: Ego4D
ego4d.accessNote: Dataset license acceptance and official downloader; component availability varies.

ego-exo4d.observations: Project Aria ego recordings synchronized with external cameras.
ego-exo4d.labels: Expert commentary, narrations, atomic actions and benchmark-specific hand/body poses.
ego-exo4d.annotationEvidence: Multi-view pose annotation and human language labeling; annotation scope is task dependent.
ego-exo4d.limitations: The reported duration sums ego and exo streams; many activities are outside manipulation.
ego-exo4d.name: Ego-Exo4D
ego-exo4d.accessNote: Dataset agreement and official download CLI.

epic-kitchens.observations: Head-mounted GoPro videos from real kitchens.
epic-kitchens.labels: Narrations, action boundaries and verb/noun labels; additional annotations are separate releases.
epic-kitchens.annotationEvidence: Participant narration and crowd-assisted temporal labeling.
epic-kitchens.limitations: EPIC-55 is included in the family and must not be added again to the 100-hour total; no 3D hand GT.
epic-kitchens.name: EPIC-KITCHENS-100
epic-kitchens.accessNote: Official download process and dataset-specific license.

hd-epic.observations: Aria sensor streams, RGB videos, gaze and spatial tracking.
hd-epic.labels: Recipes, fine-grained actions, object motion, hand masks and 3D-grounded VQA.
hd-epic.annotationEvidence: Detailed human annotation grounded in scanned kitchens and device tracking.
hd-epic.limitations: Kitchen-focused validation data; object masks and motion labels are not full hand-action ground truth.
hd-epic.name: HD-EPIC
hd-epic.accessNote: Official dataset download links and component downloader.

assembly101.observations: Eight static and four egocentric camera views of toy assembly.
assembly101.labels: Coarse/fine action segments and 3D hand poses.
assembly101.annotationEvidence: Human action annotation with automatically generated hand pose tracks.
assembly101.limitations: Pose labels are model-derived; AssemblyHands reuses this capture source.
assembly101.name: Assembly101
assembly101.accessNote: Official download scripts and noncommercial dataset terms.

hot3d.observations: Aria RGB/monochrome streams and Quest 3 monochrome stereo; gaze on Aria subset.
hot3d.labels: 3D hand shape/pose, rigid-object pose, camera calibration and object models.
hot3d.annotationEvidence: Optical motion capture and fitted hand/object meshes.
hot3d.limitations: Controlled indoor scenes and known rigid objects; contact geometry is not measured tactile force.
hot3d.name: HOT3D
hot3d.accessNote: Hugging Face / Aria download route under dataset terms.

hoi4d.observations: Head-mounted RGB-D recordings in indoor rooms.
hoi4d.labels: Hand pose, object pose, panoptic/motion segmentation and action segments.
hoi4d.limitations: Labels are reconstructed and manually refined; no executable robot action labels.
hoi4d.name: HOI4D
hoi4d.accessNote: Follow the official data access and annotation instructions; release.txt identifies public sequences.

arctic.observations: Synchronized egocentric and external RGB video.
arctic.labels: Hand/object meshes, articulated object motion and dynamic contact labels.
arctic.annotationEvidence: Marker-based motion capture fitted to scanned models.
arctic.limitations: Laboratory capture; geometric contact is not a tactile sensor measurement.
arctic.name: ARCTIC
arctic.accessNote: Registration and dataset/model license conditions apply.

egodex.observations: 30 Hz 1080p egocentric video from Apple Vision Pro.
egodex.labels: Head/upper-body/hand transforms, optional confidence and generated language descriptions.
egodex.annotationEvidence: ARKit tracking in a per-session origin frame; language generated by LLM/VLM.
egodex.limitations: Device tracking is not independent mocap GT; RGB reprojection can differ from tracked camera geometry.
egodex.name: EgoDex
egodex.accessNote: Direct Apple CDN archives; dataset CC BY-NC-ND.

egoverse.observations: Egocentric recordings from heterogeneous capture systems and operators.
egoverse.labels: Hand/body tracking, camera pose and language; annotation fields vary by source.
egoverse.annotationEvidence: Source-specific tracking pipelines normalized into EgoDB.
egoverse.limitations: Release snapshots grow and are reprocessed; sensor and annotation quality vary across sources.
egoverse.name: EgoVerse
egoverse.accessNote: Use the official dataset browser and download instructions; verify source-specific terms.

fpha.observations: Head-mounted RGB-D recordings of daily hand actions.
fpha.labels: 3D hand joints, action classes and object 6DoF poses for a subset.
fpha.annotationEvidence: Magnetic sensors and inverse kinematics generate hand pose reference labels.
fpha.limitations: Small participant/object set; sensors affect hand appearance and not every joint is directly measured.
fpha.name: FPHA
fpha.accessNote: Official project links a dataset request form; see repository for maintained access instructions.

h2o.observations: Egocentric and external Azure Kinect RGB-D streams.
h2o.labels: Left/right 3D hand pose, object pose, camera pose and interaction labels.
h2o.annotationEvidence: Multi-view model fitting, RGB-D object tracking and manual refinement.
h2o.limitations: Semi-automatic pose labels and controlled activities; action categories are not robot commands.
h2o.name: H2O
h2o.accessNote: Official downloader selects full data or pose-only data.

assemblyhands.observations: Synchronized ego and exo images sampled from Assembly101.
assemblyhands.labels: 3D hand joints with calibrated camera/image metadata.
assemblyhands.annotationEvidence: Manual annotations seed multi-view automatic pose-label generation.
assemblyhands.limitations: Derived from Assembly101, so capture hours must not be counted twice; labels retain model error.
assemblyhands.name: AssemblyHands
assemblyhands.accessNote: CC BY-NC 4.0; official toolkit documents raw and rectified image access.

show3d.observations: Quest stereo and backpack-mounted external camera videos.
show3d.labels: Hand meshes/poses, object poses for a subset, calibration and action captions.
show3d.annotationEvidence: Markerless multi-view tracking and optimization with separate quality validation.
show3d.limitations: Object-pose availability varies by scene; tracking annotations are not direct force measurements.
show3d.name: SHOW3D
show3d.accessNote: Hugging Face release and official loader; test poses are withheld.

ego-1k.observations: Multi-camera fisheye recordings and rectified stereo views.
ego-1k.labels: Calibrated camera geometry and derived stereo information.
ego-1k.annotationEvidence: Hardware synchronization and geometric calibration; stereo depth is estimated.
ego-1k.limitations: The large capture rig differs from lightweight glasses; no independent hand/depth GT is established here.
ego-1k.name: Ego-1K
ego-1k.accessNote: Official release under FAIR noncommercial research license.

holoassist.observations: HoloLens RGB-D, hand/head tracking, gaze, audio and inertial streams.
holoassist.labels: Action segments, conversation, mistakes, interventions and hand trajectories.
holoassist.annotationEvidence: Device tracking plus manual action/conversation annotation.
holoassist.limitations: Hand pose is device-estimated; assistant benchmarks do not establish robot policy performance.
holoassist.name: HoloAssist
holoassist.accessNote: Official repository states dataset is released under permissive CDLA 2.0.

nymeria.observations: Multi-device Project Aria head/wrist recordings and additional observer views.
nymeria.labels: Localized body motion, spatial tracking and language annotations; newer releases add modalities/representations.
nymeria.annotationEvidence: Synchronized wearable capture and motion-capture suit; processed and retargeted motion outputs.
nymeria.limitations: Full-body reference motion relies on a suit; original capture does not provide independent dense finger GT.
nymeria.name: Nymeria / NymeriaPlus
nymeria.accessNote: Use the official release selector and downloader; legacy Nymeria and NymeriaPlus loaders differ.

egobody.observations: Synchronized HoloLens 2 ego sensing and multiple external Azure Kinect RGB-D streams.
egobody.labels: SMPL-X body fits, 3D scenes and head/hand/gaze tracking.
egobody.annotationEvidence: Multi-view RGB-D body-model fitting with human quality control.
egobody.limitations: Social-interaction and body-shape benchmark; body fits are not a direct robot action representation.
egobody.name: EgoBody
egobody.accessNote: Signed dataset license required; separate terms for motion text labels.

aria-everyday-activities.observations: Project Aria sensor streams from daily scenarios.
aria-everyday-activities.labels: Globally aligned trajectories, scene point clouds, eye gaze and speech transcription.
aria-everyday-activities.annotationEvidence: Machine Perception Services outputs and speech annotation.
aria-everyday-activities.limitations: SLAM/MPS results are estimated context; dense hand/body action GT is not implied.
aria-everyday-activities.name: Aria Everyday Activities
aria-everyday-activities.accessNote: Aria dataset agreement and official downloader.

aria-digital-twin.observations: Raw Aria camera/inertial streams plus separate synthetic renderings.
aria-digital-twin.labels: Device/object/human poses, scene/object models, segmentation and reference depth.
aria-digital-twin.annotationEvidence: Digital scene reconstruction, motion capture and rendering generate reference annotations.
aria-digital-twin.limitations: Reference depth is not acquired by an onboard depth sensor; current docs contain inconsistent sequence totals.
aria-digital-twin.name: Aria Digital Twin
aria-digital-twin.accessNote: Use current official download manifest; data groups and GT vary per sequence.

world-in-your-hands.observations: Wearable perception rig, glove IMUs and finger pressure sensors; hardware-synchronized cameras.
world-in-your-hands.labels: Hand/wrist trajectories, derived depth/masks and language descriptions.
world-in-your-hands.annotationEvidence: Sensor-assisted motion capture and automatic annotation pipeline.
world-in-your-hands.limitations: Collection scale and accessible release scale must be checked separately; tracking is not glasses-only.
world-in-your-hands.name: World In Your Hands
world-in-your-hands.accessNote: Official site provides sample/full-data instructions; independent count of public hours not verified.

egolife.observations: Wearable first-person videos with synchronized third-person references.
egolife.labels: Long-context question answering and daily-life event annotations.
egolife.annotationEvidence: Human daily-life capture and extensive event/QA annotation.
egolife.limitations: A life-assistant dataset rather than metric manipulation-action supervision.
egolife.name: EgoLife
egolife.accessNote: Official Hugging Face collection; dataset components have their own access terms.

touch-and-go.observations: First-person RGB and synchronized handheld GelSight tactile video.
touch-and-go.annotationEvidence: Measured optical tactile observations with human material labeling.
touch-and-go.limitations: A held probe measures contact; this is not bare-hand whole-surface tactile or robot action data.
touch-and-go.name: Touch and Go
touch-and-go.accessNote: Official Google Drive data links; see paper/repository terms.

egotouch.observations: Head camera, two wrist cameras and palm pressure arrays.
egotouch.labels: 42-joint hand pose and time-aligned continuous pressure maps.
egotouch.annotationEvidence: Wearable pressure measurements and sensor-assisted pose capture.
egotouch.limitations: The 16×16 arrays mainly cover each palm; predicted pressure is separate from measured labels.
egotouch.name: EgoTouch / TouchAnything
egotouch.accessNote: Official Hugging Face repository is public and ungated; download listing verified 2026-10-16.

emg2pose.observations: Wrist sEMG aligned at 2 kHz with per-hand joint angles.
emg2pose.limitations: Reference dataset: no paired egocentric RGB is established; do not merge it with EgoEMG.
emg2pose.name: emg2pose
emg2pose.accessNote: Full and mini datasets available; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

touchscale.observations: Head RGB-D, dual wrist RGB and full-hand pressure gloves.
touchscale.labels: Time-aligned tactile outputs, instructions and capture metadata.
touchscale.annotationEvidence: Measured glove normal-pressure signals with automated completeness and quality checks.
touchscale.limitations: Paper reports 500 hours; the current card documents a 100-hour subset. No failure examples in that release.
touchscale.name: TouchScale
touchscale.accessNote: Official dataset card: CC BY-NC 4.0; full 500-hour release planned before November 2026.

interhand26m.observations: Studio RGB views of single and interacting hands.
interhand26m.labels: 3D hand pose and later fitted hand meshes.
interhand26m.limitations: Reference dataset rather than egocentric daily manipulation; no object dynamics or robot actions.
interhand26m.name: InterHand2.6M
interhand26m.accessNote: Official download links and noncommercial research terms.

egogesture.observations: Egocentric RGB-D gesture videos in six scene conditions.
egogesture.labels: Gesture class and temporal start/end boundaries.
egogesture.annotationEvidence: Designed gesture protocol and manually segmented class labels.
egogesture.limitations: Gesture recognition resource; not dense 3D hand pose or manipulation-action supervision.
egogesture.name: EgoGesture
egogesture.accessNote: Sign agreement and email the listed contact; approval provides download links.

sanpo.observations: Head/chest stereo video, camera pose and inertial data; separate synthetic scenes.
sanpo.labels: Semantic masks and derived depth maps.
sanpo.annotationEvidence: Human segmentation plus stereo/model-derived depth; synthetic labels are rendered.
sanpo.limitations: Navigation-focused; dense depth includes inferred values and is not independent depth-sensor GT.
sanpo.name: SANPO

ego-gen.observations: Rendered first-person views generated from simulated body motion and scene assets.
ego-gen.labels: Synthetic body pose, camera trajectories, geometry and rendering outputs.
ego-gen.annotationEvidence: Simulation-generated annotations rather than physical sensor measurement.
ego-gen.limitations: Synthetic resource; realism and asset distributions must be tested before transfer claims.
ego-gen.name: EgoGen
ego-gen.accessNote: Official code and pretrained assets have component-specific terms.

taco.observations: Egocentric and third-person views of tool use and coordinated object manipulation.
taco.annotationEvidence: Multi-view capture combined with optical motion capture.
taco.limitations: Studio protocol; geometric contact and cooperative grasp synthesis are not measured tactile force.
taco.name: TACO
taco.accessNote: Official V1 dataset link and use terms.

oakink2.observations: Synchronized multi-view image streams of complex task completion.
oakink2.labels: 3D human/hands/objects, primitive text and task dependency graphs.
oakink2.annotationEvidence: Sensor-assisted capture and fitted 3D human/object representations.
oakink2.limitations: Released annotations are labeled preview and may change; body-model fields do not imply all joints are used.
oakink2.name: OakInk2
oakink2.accessNote: Official Hugging Face tarballs; annotations are preview releases.

hocap.observations: Multiple RealSense RGB-D cameras and a HoloLens headset.
hocap.labels: Object models, hand/object poses and segmentation.
hocap.annotationEvidence: Semi-automatic shape/pose annotation from RGB-D; no motion-capture system required.
hocap.limitations: Reference poses are optimized annotations rather than independent mocap measurements.
hocap.name: HO-Cap
hocap.accessNote: Official download scripts and Box archives; CC BY 4.0.

egohos.observations: Egocentric RGB images drawn from manipulation videos.
egohos.labels: Hand masks, interacted-object masks and contact-boundary labels.
egohos.annotationEvidence: Manual image segmentation and contact-boundary annotation.
egohos.limitations: Image-level contact masks do not provide metric 3D contact force or robot commands.
egohos.name: EgoHOS
egohos.accessNote: Official repository provides annotation and image download instructions.

aria-gen2-pilot.observations: Aria Gen 2 raw sensing during cleaning, cooking, eating, play and outdoor walking.
aria-gen2-pilot.labels: Machine-perception outputs for wearer, scene and interaction context.
aria-gen2-pilot.annotationEvidence: Device sensing with estimated perception outputs; fields follow release-specific documentation.
aria-gen2-pilot.limitations: Incremental pilot collection; algorithm outputs should not be relabeled as independent GT.
aria-gen2-pilot.name: Aria Gen 2 Pilot Dataset
aria-gen2-pilot.accessNote: Official Project Aria dataset page and release-specific terms.
